$comment: FILL-IN TEMPLATE — full-reference mode (Ref2VA). Replace every <ANGLE_BRACKET> slot and delete this $comment plus any *_help key. Section KEY ORDER below is fixed and checked; do not reorder. Slot rules: docs/prompting/h3-prompt-template.md.

subject_definitions.$comment: The ONLY section that may introduce a label. Every label defined here must be used somewhere, and every label used anywhere must be defined here.
subject_definitions.label: <<Subject 1> | <Picture 1> | <Video 1> | <Audio 1>>
subject_definitions.definition: <SERVICE PROSE. What the label denotes, its reference role, and the features to follow. No leading 'is' — the renderer supplies it.>

subject_definitions.label: <Audio 1>
subject_definitions.definition: <e.g. the voice-timbre reference containing a spoken English vocal layer>
subject_definitions.speaker_id: <S1 — only when this audio maps to a target speaker. Reuses the global id; never assigns a new one.>

task_types: <keyframe completion | reference generation | video editing | video continuation | audio reuse | audio reference>
<second type only if a second relationship genuinely applies — no repeats>
summary.text: <ONE SHORT PARAGRAPH. The target video and its reference relationships, using labels already defined above. Introduce no new labels.>

retention_analysis.$comment: One entry per label. Visual labels draw from the visual marker table; <Audio N> draws from the audio table. No speaker ids anywhere in this section.
retention_analysis.label: <Subject 1>
retention_analysis.detail: <SERVICE PROSE. What is retained, changed, transferred, or only loosely echoed.>

retention_analysis.label: <Audio 1>
retention_analysis.detail: <e.g. its timbre guides delivery without copying the original signal>

shots.$comment: Supplied as `shots` in every mode; renders as detailed_description here. Aim 350-500 words across the shots for a generation task.
shots.style: <Cinematic | live-action | 2D-animated | 3D CG | claymation | watercolor | vintage film>
shots.description: <SERVICE PROSE. Describe each label at its first clear appearance: referenced features, position in frame, current action. May contain labels.>

dialogue.identity: <SERVICE PROSE. Voice and delivery, rendered outside the delimiters.>
dialogue.text: <CALLER TEXT. Verbatim. Use [unclear] for unintelligible source spans rather than guessing.>

overall_soundscape: <1-4 SENTENCES. Ambience and physical sound across the whole video. Cite a copied ambience label here if one applies. N/A only for requested silence.>
non_diegetic_music: <1-3 SENTENCES. Audience-only score, or the reused audio label serving as it. Instrumentation, tempo, dynamics. N/A when there is none.>
